review.images: Beachfront, aerial, terrace, pool and arrival renders are credited to The Boundary, which produced them with Aldar. The residence living and bedroom renders match imagery printed in the brochure and were sourced without adjacent marketing copy from Sky Land’s project gallery. The original lobby render is from Aldar’s brochure.
review.location: The complete left map panel on physical page 10 identifies Nobu in the district inset and shows Aldar’s 20-minute airport estimate. Four additional timings and the airport estimate are from Property Finder’s Nobu project page. No surveyed entrances.
review.floorPlans: Reviewed all seven complete residence layouts on physical pages 46–52. Pages 36–38 render the same three floor-plan images as pages 46–48, so the on-page section uses only the residence set. The distinct loft variants each show 446 m² as printed. No independent whole-unit recalculation was applied.

unavailable: Signed measurement basis and precise building entrances.
